recent death of their spouse. Sertraline is prescribed. The patient expresses
that she doesn’t want to be on medication long-term. Which response is

pearls: A young adult meets the criteria for MDD and is prescribed fluoxetine 20 mg daily. Which of the following differentials must be excluded before prescribing an SSRI? 1. Obsessive compulsive disorder 2. Panic disorder 3. Bipolar disorder 4. Generalized anxiety disorder
Screen for Bipolar Disorder • Major depression may be a presenting symptom of bipolar • Screen: Mood Disorder Questionnaire (15-item, self-report) • Sensitivity 58%; Specificity 93%

Bipolar Disorder NOTES Bipolar I: one or more manic or hypomanic episode, less likely to have a major depressive episode Bipolar II: one episode of hypomania, at least one episode of major depression, and no history of mania If bipolar is suspected: • Do not initiate antidepressants • REFER!
